description: This file defines the ByteArray class, which provides methods for manipulating byte arrays, including encoding, comparison, bitwise operations, and conversions to string. It is part of the AWS SDK's cryptographic polyfill components.

classes.name: ByteArray
classes.description: A class extending SplFixedArray to handle byte-level operations used in cryptography, such as encoding, comparison, bitwise XOR, and other byte manipulations.

methods.name: __construct
methods.description: Constructs a ByteArray instance from an integer, string, array, or another ByteArray.

methods.name: enc32be
methods.description: Static method to encode a 32-bit unsigned integer into a ByteArray in big-endian order.

methods.name: equals
methods.description: Compares this ByteArray to another for equality.

methods.name: exclusiveOr
methods.description: Performs a bitwise XOR with another ByteArray of the same size.

methods.name: getIncremented
methods.description: Returns a new ByteArray incremented by a specified value.

methods.name: offsetSet
methods.description: Sets a byte value at a specific index, ensuring it's within 0-255.

methods.name: rshift
methods.description: Returns a bitwise right-shifted copy of the ByteArray.

methods.name: select
methods.description: Constant-time select between two ByteArrays based on a boolean-like switch.

methods.name: set
methods.description: Copies bytes from another ByteArray into this one with an offset.

methods.name: slice
methods.description: Returns a slice of the ByteArray as a new ByteArray.

methods.name: zeroize
methods.description: Overwrites all bytes with zeros for secure data cleanup.

methods.name: toString
methods.description: Converts the ByteArray to a raw binary string.
